name: Drawer
summary: A full height panel over the page at the inline end or start, for a secondary task such as filters or the details of a selected item. Modal by default; non modal keeps the page usable next to it.
useWhen: Filters or settings for the list or canvas on the page
The details of a selected item, read next to the page (modal false)
A form too long for a Dialog that still belongs to the current page
avoidWhen: A short decision or a form of a few fields
Phone layouts where the panel should rise from the bottom
Navigation between sections of the app
A question about an action that cannot be undone

onOpenChange.description: Called with false for Escape, a backdrop click, the close control and DrawerClose.

size.description: The width from the dialog.width tokens: 360, 440, 520 and 640 px. Under breakpoint.phone it fills the width.

side.description: The edge it comes from, in reading order: end is the right in English and the left in Arabic.

modal.description: true: a backdrop covers the page, focus stays inside and the page does not scroll. false: no backdrop, no focus trap, and a click on the page keeps the drawer open.

dismissible.description: false: Escape and a backdrop click do nothing and the close control is aria-disabled. For short waits while an action runs.

title.description: DrawerContent: the title for the common case, the same as a DrawerTitle child.

description.description: DrawerContent: the description for the common case.

closeLabel.description: DrawerContent: the accessible name of the close control. Arabic default under lang ar: إغلاق الشريط الجانبي.

rootProps.description: DrawerContent: props for the root layer. className and style go to the root too; ref and every other prop go to the panel, Radix Content props included.

DrawerTrigger.description: One child element, a system Button, rendered as the trigger (always asChild). Focus returns to it on close.

DrawerClose.description: One child element, a system Button that closes the drawer (always asChild), marked data-dialog-cancel.

data-autofocus.description: Put on any focusable element inside the drawer to take focus on open.

a11y.role: dialog (the panel). Modal by default: Radix hides the rest of the page from assistive tech and keeps focus inside. With modal false it is not modal: the page stays reachable. Named by the title, described by the description.
a11y.focus: The Dialog focus rule: an element marked data-autofocus, else the first field in the body, else the first footer action that is not tone danger, else the close control. On close, focus returns to the trigger, or to the element that had focus before.

keys.Escape: Closes the drawer, unless dismissible is false
keys.Tab: Modal: moves to the next control inside the drawer and wraps from the last to the first
keys.Shift+Tab: Modal: moves to the previous control inside the drawer and wraps from the first to the last

a11y.announce: The title and the description are read when the drawer opens. Loading and errors in the body use role status and role alert.
notes: data-side holds start or end; start is the right in Arabic, and the slide mirrors with the reading direction.
A body taller than the screen scrolls inside and joins the tab order while it scrolls. The header and the footer stay in view.
Toasts sit above an open drawer and stay readable and clickable, as with Dialog.

Non modal: Tab leaves the drawer for the page, as for any region. Escape from inside the drawer closes it; an Escape in a page field stays with that field. When the drawer closes while the person works on the page, focus stays where it is.
Order 1.23 motion: the backdrop blurs the page in as a dialog does. Order 1.29 adds the swipe to dismiss (below).

Order 1.29, swipe to dismiss: the handle part, a strip on the panel edge that faces the page (at the top on platform ios), takes a drag toward the edge the drawer sits on. The panel follows the pointer by transform, gives a rubber band against the edge (and toward it when dismissible is false), and closes on release past a quarter of its width or on a flick; otherwise it springs back. The handle is hidden from assistive tech: the close control (the button path) and Escape (the key path) are the same action (WCAG 2.5.7). The math is shared with Angular (packages/motion helpers/drawer-swipe.ts).

en.title: A noun phrase for the task: Filter boards, Board activity.
en.description: One sentence about what the drawer changes or shows.
en.buttons: Verb plus noun: Apply filters, Clear filters. Never OK or Continue.

ar.title: Noun form, no diacritics: فلترة اللوحات
ar.buttons: Noun form labels: تطبيق الفلاتر، مسح الفلاتر.

react.note: Built on DialogBase (Dialog folder). Styled by the drawer block of Dialog.css.

angular.note: On the Angular Dialog layer, with data-side and the header part.

native.note: Tablets only: a side panel. Phones use Sheet.

styles.studio: A full height surface panel with the inner corners rounded, the header band on surface-2 with the CloseButton, the footer band. It slides in from its side on duration.slow, ease.emphasized.
styles.desk: The Desk dialog glass, hairline and window shadow, with the window radius on the inner corners. The slide keeps duration.slow and ease.emphasized.

mistakes.right: side start or end: the drawer mirrors in Arabic

mistakes.wrong: A drawer for a two button decision
mistakes.right: Dialog, or AlertDialog when it cannot be undone

mistakes.wrong: A modal drawer for details the person reads next to the page
Waiting for animationend before removing a closed drawer
mistakes.right: Dialog.css sets the animations to none under reduced motion, so Radix removes it at once
